text:
jordan: Heads-up: onboarding sample app failing because SDKs return different error shapes for the same 401. Node gives AuthFailure with fields, Python raises HTTPError with raw response body. Breaks retry helpers and UX.

maria: Can you paste the repro and exact outputs?

jordan: Minimal call is a single generate() after onboarding. Examples: 
# node (sdk-js)
AuthFailure: token_expired (status=401)
 at request(...)
# python (sdk-py)
HTTPError: 401 Client Error: Unauthorized for url: https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
response: {"error":{"type":"auth_error","message":"token invalid","code":401}}

sam: We planned exception parity. Proposal: small typed hierarchy across SDKs with fields: .name, .status_code, .code (string), .retryable (bool), .details (raw). Keeps idiomatic classes + consistent contract for DX and our retry libs.

kevin: Current retry behavior: SDKs refresh token once on 401 and retry; only 429/5xx use backoff. If 401 surfaces as generic HTTPError without fields, auto-refresh misses it.

maria: Proposed status->exception mapping: 401->AuthFailure (retryable=false by default, but SDK may refresh and retry once), 403->PermissionDenied (retryable=false), 429->RateLimited (retryable=true), 5xx->ServerError (retryable=true). Include retry_after when present.

sam: I'll draft an RFC and a shared testsuite snippet asserting these fields exist. Canonical shape example: {"name":"AuthFailure","status_code":401,"code":"token_expired","retryable":false,"details":{"refresh_attempted":true}}

jordan: Onboarding sample should catch typed exceptions instead of parsing strings; currently it displays raw HTTP body.

devex-bot: Issue created: RED-DEVEX-1234 — "SDK parity: standardize exception shapes + update onboarding sample" assigned to sam. :white_check_mark:

sam: Plan: 1) define canonical error contract in sdk-common, 2) implement in sdk-js + sdk-py, 3) add integration tests in CI, 4) update sample app and docs. Target PR this week.

maria: Add migration note and a short snippet for onboarding (two lines) showing catching AuthFailure vs broad Exception.

jordan: Clarify auth retry guidance: SDKs should attempt token refresh once on 401, then surface AuthFailure with retryable=false. Rate limits should set retryable=true and honor retry_after.

kevin: I'll add infra tests simulating various status codes and assert retry behavior.

jordan: Thanks — @sam ping me when PR is up and I'll update the onboarding app. :thumbsup:
